title: Clinician-Friendly Foundation Models for Ophthalmic Image Diagnostics without Fine-Tuning or Technical Barriers
abstract: arXiv:2504.15928v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) shows remarkable potential in medical imaging diagnostics, yet most current models require retraining when applied across different clinical settings, limiting their scalability. We developed GlobeReady, a deployment-oriented platform powered by the RetiGlobe foun- dation model and local feature augmentation. RetiGlobe was pretrained in two stages: 1) self-supervised learning using DINOv2 on 38 million synthetic ophthalmic images, and 2) contrastive learning using CLIP on 475,845 real image-text pairs spanning diverse ethnicities, imaging devices, and geographic regions worldwide. We evaluate GlobeReady on 488,448 ophthalmic images, including color fundus photographs (CFPs) and optical coherence tomography scans, from multi-centres in China, Singapore, Vietnam and the UK. translated_title: 无需微调或技术门槛的临床医生友好型眼科图像诊断基础模型
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）在医学影像诊断中展现出巨大潜力，但目前大多数模型在应用于不同临床环境时需要重新训练，限制了其可扩展性。我们开发了GlobeReady，这是一个以RetiGlobe基础模型和局部特征增强为支撑、面向部署应用的平台。RetiGlobe通过两个阶段进行预训练：1）使用DINOv2在3800万张合成眼科图像上进行自监督学习；2）使用CLIP在覆盖全球不同种族、成像设备和地理区域的475,845对真实图文对上进行对比学习。我们在来自中国、新加坡、越南和英国多中心的488,448张眼科图像上对GlobeReady进行了评估，这些图像包括彩色眼底照片（CFP）和光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像。前瞻性测试包括31名眼科医生参与的系统可用性评估。探索性分析评估了模型的跨领域泛化能力。
tldr: 开发了基于RetiGlobe基础模型的GlobeReady部署平台，通过在数千万合成眼科图像及全球多中心真实图文数据上进行两阶段预训练，实现了无需微调即可在不同临床环境和中国、新加坡、越南、英国等多国医疗场景中直接使用的眼科图像诊断系统，并经眼科医生验证了其临床可用性。
en_tdlr: We developed GlobeReady, a deployment-ready platform powered by the RetiGlobe foundation model pretrained on 38 million synthetic images and 475,845 real image-text pairs, enabling clinician-friendly ophthalmic image diagnostics across diverse ethnicities, devices, and countries without fine-tuning or technical barriers.
